findings.claim: The new GetPropertyIdentifierLocation helper still indexes DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0], so the BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull path continues to throw IndexOutOfRangeException for a property on a metadata symbol. For example, a referenced generic struct with [Key(null)] on a property, consumed as Item<int> by a source [MessagePackObject], still makes the analyzer throw instead of dropping the metadata diagnostic; the helper's documentation and return contract are also contradicted by its implementation.

receipt_plan.detail: Compile a Lib assembly containing [MessagePackObject] generic struct Item<T> with a [Key(null)] property, reference its metadata image from an app containing [MessagePackObject] Cmd with an Item<int> keyed member, and run MessagePackGenerator plus all MessagePack analyzers. On head, MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer throws AD0001/IndexOutOfRangeException at GetPropertyIdentifierLocation instead of completing cleanly.
